name: PNC Financial Services
legalName: The PNC Financial Services Group, Inc.
description: PNC is a Pittsburgh-based bank holding company with $573.6B of assets, $440.9B of deposits and $331.5B of loans. It earns money mainly from the spread between deposit and loan rates (net interest income $14.4B of $23.1B revenue) and from fees such as treasury management, capital markets, card, and asset management. Its three reporting segments are Retail Banking, Corporate & Institutional Banking (the biggest earner by segment net income) and the small Asset Management Group. It closed the $26.4B-asset FirstBank (Colorado) acquisition on 2026-01-05.

employees.note: 53,859 full-time plus 1,474 part-time; 27,595 of them in Retail Banking (10-K Item 1).

businessLines.name: Retail Banking
businessLines.how: Consumer and small-business deposits, residential mortgages, home equity, auto and credit card lending, brokerage and insurance through a coast-to-coast branch network, digital and phone channels; 79 percent of segment revenue is net interest income (11,815 of 14,863, computed) and the rest fees.

revenue.note: Segment revenue; shares below are of the 27,801 segment total, not of the 23,099 consolidated revenue (other activities net to -4,702).

businessLines.revenueNote: Segment revenue; shares below are of the 27,801 segment total, not of the 23,099 consolidated revenue (other activities net to -4,702).

businessLines.name: Corporate & Institutional Banking
businessLines.how: Lends to, and holds deposits for, mid-sized and large corporations, governments and not-for-profits; earns the lending spread plus treasury-management, capital markets and advisory fees and commercial mortgage servicing income; 39 percent of segment revenue is noninterest income (4,342 of 11,228, computed).

businessLines.name: Asset Management Group
businessLines.how: Private bank for affluent individuals, plus institutional asset management: fees on discretionary client assets (PNC Private Bank 138B and Institutional Asset Management 96B under management at 2025-12-31) plus deposit and lending spread; 59 percent of revenue is noninterest income (1,001 of 1,710).

businessLines.name: Other activities (not allocated to segments)
businessLines.how: Residual: items not attributed to the three segments (balance-sheet funding and asset and liability management, corporate items); not a customer business.

brands.name: FirstBank Holding Company / FirstBank (Colorado)
brands.note: Acquisition completed 2026-01-05; at close $26.4B assets, $16.0B loans, $23.1B deposits. Not in 2025 figures.
